title: 第19章 女神的小裤裤第20章 你们中出了一个叛徒
content_zh:
第十九章女神的小裤裤
此时面对五条比他还要大的紫色巨蛇，郝宁心中紧张无比，他甚至怀疑子弹能不能穿透紫色巨蛇的皮肤。
同时郝宁也向着巨蛇和艾尔丽萨使用侦察术，结果令他难以相信，竟然什么资料都没有！
他额间不由冒出一丝丝冷汗，根本查不出等级，可想而知他们之间的实力差距有多么大。
“不要弄坏了这具身体，我似乎发现这具身体好像更有趣了，他的身上有一种诱人的气息！”
那个占据着黛西身体的艾尔丽萨端坐在箱子之上，对郝宁做出一个妩媚的动作，配上属于黛西的容貌，顿时让郝宁心中一突。
“这位……这位美女，你想要我的身体吗！那我脱衣服了！”
郝宁脸上挤出一个自认为不错笑容.
“似乎挺有趣的嘛，把你的衣服脱了吧！我也想看看你的身体究竟是怎么样子的，那种味道真是太诱人了！”
艾尔丽萨脸上露出感兴趣的表情，刹那间伸出手臂去止住欲欲跃试的五条紫色巨蛇，就差那么一点点几条巨蛇就将郝宁生吞活剥了。
美丽的紫色牢笼内黛西躺在地上奄奄一息，五条巨蛇对着他露出不善的眼神。
剩下来的事情只能依靠郝宁身体内的商店系统了，忽然他将物品栏中的怨灵石掏出来。
郝宁没有忘记一件事情，那就是先把将早已用完的购买点数补充一下，如果他继续维持购买点数为0的状态，只有死路一条。
就在兑换的瞬间异象突生，一个狰狞的人影直接在他面前直接浮现，转眼即逝，随着怨灵石被绞碎，人影也消逝在空气中。
虽然过程短暂，但他还是将那个人影的模样看得一清二楚，那不是在监狱已经死去的狱卒威尔吗？
怎么会出现在这里，难道是因为手中怨灵石的缘故，他心中涌起一阵后怕，如果他不是因为兑换将怨灵石拿出来，那么他面对的将是一只凶猛的怨灵。
在确定狱卒威尔不会再次出现后，郝宁小心翼翼地望向坐在箱子上的艾尔丽萨，唯恐她会发现什么，一时兴起就将他给杀了！
“快点脱吧！想不到这里会有那些让人讨厌的怨灵，那些可悲的灵魂，你说是吧，这位修女！”
只见艾尔丽萨轻描淡写地说了一句话，并未作出什么动作。
而躺在地上的黛西仿佛死去一般，根本没有力气回答她的问题。

郝宁暗暗松了一口气，把目光投向购买点数，这么一看直把他吓了一跳，竟然多出了1000购买点数！这是他兑换得到最多购买点数的一次。
现在只要在目录中找到有用的东西就能拥有一线生机，他一边脱着衣服，一边尝试调出商店目录，而边上的艾尔丽萨并未表现出任何异样的表情。
看来这个目录只有郝宁自己能够看见，确认这个事情后他就放心了。
但现在给郝宁的时间并不多，因为他必须在脱衣这个过程中找到对自己有用的东西，他的性命全都系在这个目录内。
时间在一点点地流逝，但郝宁在目录里面根本找不到任何能够帮助他的道具，就算那些道具有希望战胜艾尔丽萨，但对郝宁也有严重的使用限制。
一分钟过后，郝宁已经脱完衣服后，精壮的身体暴露在空气中，就连身下的小郝宁也昂首挺胸。
但他的脸色一片苍白，仿佛此时已经宣判他的死刑，难道努力都要白费了吗？他都已经兑换到1000购买点数了！
就在这时候艾尔丽萨仿佛对郝宁失去了耐性，随手一挥，一股强大的力量瞬间将郝宁捆绑住，令他动弹不得。
“我已经对你的身体失去兴趣了，不如我们来进行一些更深入的事情吧，我对你身体内的东西很感兴趣哦！”艾尔丽萨一个闪现，整个身体都挂在郝宁身上幽幽地说道。
忽然艾尔丽萨搂住郝宁的脑袋，唇瓣吻上他的双唇，两人的身体更是毫无缝隙地贴合在一起。
此时郝宁整个脸庞涨得通红，虽然他知道眼前的女人很危险，但这种看着不能吃的感觉非常难受，他恨不得现在立即去死算了。
“呜呜…………”
郝宁想不到自己竟然会有被女人强吻的一天，而且这个女人前一秒还是一条冰冷的死尸，忽然他看到在艾尔丽萨身后竟然涌现出一个紫色的虚幻黑影，那是一朵艳丽的紫色玫瑰。
就在这时候，庞大的紫色能量从艾尔丽萨嘴里涌出，向着郝宁身体内涌去。
艾尔丽萨可不会像黛西那么温柔，巨大的能量冲击几乎让郝宁翻白眼，他的意识也在渐渐地消失。
刹那间郝宁脑海中涌现出罗尔与郝宁自己的记忆，他的脑海仿佛在回顾着这一生，直到这场漫长的“电影”放完，一句话在他心底响起。
“你真的要就这么放弃了吗？”
这么简单的一句话仿佛一柄尖刀插在郝宁心中，他真的要放弃吗？前世每次遇到困难他都会选择放弃，选择逃避，但现在他真的能够放弃吗？
“不！我不会放弃，我要活下去！”
郝宁从心底中发出怒吼，渐渐地郝宁与罗尔的记忆重叠在一起，直到现在郝宁才算真正的继承了罗尔的一切。

当郝宁心中燃起生存的希望，并且恢复意识的时候，他的个人面板上竟然闪耀着一阵金色光芒。
“叮，恭喜宿主郝宁完成隐藏任务《真正的自己》！”
“郝宁获得任务奖励：女神的小裤裤！”
信息栏上那段紫色的文字触动着郝宁的内心，而且竟然还是史诗级道具！他连忙点开道具信息，说不定这件道具能够救他。
某位女神的小裤裤（史诗级）
效果：只要将小裤裤套在头上，并且消耗100购买点数，就可以指定任何等级的目标将其封印，如果你使用时能够喊出女神名字，效果将会得到增强。
冷却时间：一个月。
备注：凡是偷看我内.裤的家伙都该死，将他们都封印到死亡那一刻吧！——来自于某位不远透露姓名的女神
如果只看效果，这件道具可以说是堪比神器，无视等级进行封印这个效果实在太BUG了！
虽然名字和使用方法是坑爹了一点，但这一点都不影响郝宁心中的兴奋！只见他手中抓着一条白色小裤裤，用尽全身力气往头上套去。
但压制郝宁的力量实在太强，导致他根本弯曲不了手臂，只差一点点就能碰到脑袋了。陡然间郝宁力气一泄，手掌一松，紧抓着的白色小裤裤轻飘飘地跌落在他头上。
“宿主郝宁使用女神的小裤裤，请选择目标与载体！”
顿时郝宁眼中出现两个写着目标和载体的标签，看着上面的提示，应该就是将两个标签分别贴在目标上。
他毅然将目标的标签贴在艾尔丽萨身上，另一个标签他犹豫了一下，他不可能将这么危险的东西封印在自己身上，忽然他看到地上的左轮手枪，顿时将标签贴了上去。
而在郝宁身体内探索的艾尔丽萨碰上了一个难题，那就是她面对着一个乌龟壳子般的房子，怎么样都进不去。
忽然一股强大的力量笼罩着她的身体，并且将她向外扯去，艾尔丽萨上一次感受到这种心生畏惧的力量时，还是那个众神的时代！
但现在这股力量究竟从哪里到来的！艾尔丽萨还没反应过来，就觉得一个力量将他扯出郝宁的身体，紧随而来就是无情的挤压，仿佛要将她塞进一个拳头那么大的小罐子。
“啊！你怎么可能拥有…………”
只见艾尔丽萨话还没说完，就被牵扯到空中，她与黛西一同化作光芒融入地上那把左轮手枪中，刹那间黑光与白光来回在枪身闪耀，仿佛水与火般的碰撞。
顿时郝宁被这股迸发的力量狠狠地甩到一旁，伤上加伤的他感觉自己的腰都快断了。

“轰！”
忽然间地上那涌动的紫色.魔纹仿佛拔掉塞子的水坝，汹涌的紫**纹汇聚成巨大光柱冲天而起，穿过密室上空岩层继续往上冲去。
如果现在在菲尼斯外面一定会看到，一条紫色光柱贯穿天际！
与此同时地面那些吞噬性命的魔纹正在一点点消退。

Chapter 19 The Goddess’s Panties
Facing five giant purple snakes that were bigger than him, Hao Ning was extremely nervous. He even doubted whether the bullet could penetrate the skin of the giant purple snake.
At the same time, Hao Ning also used reconnaissance techniques on the giant snake and Ellisa. The result was unbelievable to him: there was no information at all!
A trace of cold sweat broke out on his forehead, and he couldn't find out his level at all. One can imagine how big the gap in strength between them was.
"Don't damage this body. I seem to find this body more interesting. He has an alluring aura!"
Ellisa, who was occupying Daisy's body, was sitting on the box and made a charming gesture towards Hao Ning. With the appearance that belonged to Daisy, Hao Ning's heart suddenly jumped.
"This...this beauty, do you want my body! Then I'll take off my clothes!"
Hao Ning squeezed out what he thought was a good smile on his face.
"It seems interesting. Take off your clothes! I also want to see what your body looks like. The smell is so tempting!"
There was an expression of interest on Ellisa's face, and in an instant she stretched out her arms to stop the five eager purple snakes, but she was just a little bit away from eating Hao Ning alive.
In a beautiful purple cage, Daisy was lying on the ground dying, and five giant snakes looked at him with evil eyes.
Hao Ning could only rely on the store system in his body for the rest. Suddenly he took out the Wraith Stone from his inventory.
Hao Ning did not forget one thing, which was to replenish the purchased points that had already been used up. If he continued to maintain the state of 0 purchasing points, there would be only a dead end.
At the moment of the exchange, a vision suddenly appeared, and a ferocious figure appeared directly in front of him. It disappeared in the blink of an eye. As the resentful spirit stone was crushed, the figure also disappeared in the air.
Although the process was short, he could still clearly see the appearance of the figure. Wasn't that the jailer Will who had died in the prison?
Why did he appear here? Could it be because of the Wraith Spirit Stone in his hand? He felt a sense of fear in his heart. If he hadn't taken out the Wraith Spirit Stone because of the exchange, then he would have faced a ferocious Wraith Spirit.
After making sure that the jailer Will would not appear again, Hao Ning carefully looked at Ellisa sitting on the box, fearing that she would find something and kill him on a whim!
"Take it off quickly! I didn't expect that there would be those annoying ghosts and miserable souls here, right? This nun!"
Ellisa said something lightly and did not make any moves.
Daisy, who was lying on the ground, seemed to be dead and had no strength to answer her questions.
Hao Ning secretly breathed a sigh of relief and turned his attention to the purchase points. He was shocked when he saw that there were 1,000 more purchase points! This is the most points he has ever redeemed for a purchase.
Now, as long as he found something useful in the catalog, he would have a chance of survival. He tried to call up the store catalog while taking off his clothes, and Ellisa beside him did not show any strange expression.
It seemed that only Hao Ning could see this directory. After confirming this, he felt relieved.
But there is not much time for Hao Ning now, because he must find something useful to him in the process of taking off his clothes. His life is all tied to this directory.
Time passed little by little, but Hao Ning couldn't find any props in the catalog that could help him. Even if those props had hope of defeating Ellisa, they also had serious restrictions on Hao Ning's use.
A minute later, Hao Ning had finished taking off his clothes, and his strong body was exposed to the air. Even the little Hao Ning underneath him stood up high.
But his face was pale, as if he had been sentenced to death. Will all his efforts be in vain? He has already redeemed itIt’s time to buy 1,000 points!
At this moment, Ellisa seemed to have lost her patience with Hao Ning. With a wave of her hand, a powerful force instantly bound Hao Ning, making him unable to move.
"I've lost interest in your body. Let's do something more in-depth. I'm very interested in what's inside your body!" Elisa flashed and said quietly, her whole body hanging on Hao Ning's body.
Suddenly, Alissa hugged Hao Ning's head and kissed his lips, their bodies fitting together seamlessly.
At this time, Hao Ning's whole face turned red. Although he knew that the woman in front of him was dangerous, the feeling of being unable to eat was very uncomfortable. He wished he could die immediately.
"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu"
Hao Ning never thought that one day he would be forcibly kissed by a woman, and this woman was a cold dead body a second ago. Suddenly, he saw an illusory purple shadow emerge behind Ellisa, which was a gorgeous purple rose.
At this moment, huge purple energy surged out of Ellisa's mouth and rushed into Hao Ning's body.
Ellisa would not be as gentle as Daisy. The huge energy shock almost made Hao Ning roll his eyes, and his consciousness was gradually disappearing.
In an instant, the memories of Luo Er and Hao Ning emerged in Hao Ning's mind. His mind seemed to be reviewing this life. Until the long "movie" ended, a sentence rang in his heart.
"Are you really going to give up just like that?"
Such a simple sentence was like a sharp knife thrust into Hao Ning's heart. Is he really going to give up? Every time he encountered difficulties in his previous life, he would choose to give up and escape, but can he really give up now?
"No! I won't give up, I want to live!"
Hao Ning roared from the bottom of his heart. Gradually, Hao Ning and Luo Er's memories overlapped. It was only now that Hao Ning truly inherited everything from Luo Er.
When the hope of survival ignited in Hao Ning's heart and he regained consciousness, a burst of golden light shone on his personal panel.
"Ding, congratulations to host Hao Ning for completing the hidden mission "The True Self"!"
"Hao Ning received the mission reward: the goddess's panties!"
The purple text on the information column touched Hao Ning's heart, and it turned out to be an epic prop! He quickly clicked on the prop information, maybe this prop could save him.
A certain goddess’s panties (epic level)
Effect: As long as you put the panties on your head and spend 100 purchase points, you can designate a target of any level to seal it. If you can shout the name of the goddess when using it, the effect will be enhanced.
Cooling time: one month.
Note: Anyone who peeks at my underwear deserves to die, seal them all until the moment of death! ——From a goddess whose name was not revealed far away
If you only look at the effect, this prop can be said to be comparable to an artifact. The effect of sealing regardless of the level is too buggy!
Although the name and usage are a bit deceiving, it does not affect Hao Ning's excitement at all! I saw him holding a pair of white pants in his hand, and using all his strength to pull them on over his head.
But the force suppressing Hao Ning was so strong that he couldn't bend his arm at all and could only barely touch his head. Suddenly, Hao Ning's strength gave out, his palms loosened, and the white panties he was clinging to fell lightly on his head.
"Host Hao Ning uses the goddess's panties, please choose the target and carrier!"
Suddenly, two labels with the target and the carrier appeared in Hao Ning's eyes. Looking at the prompts above, he should stick the two labels on the target respectively.
He resolutely put the target label on Ellisa. He hesitated for another label. It was impossible for him to seal such a dangerous thing on himself. Suddenly he saw the revolver on the ground and paused.Then put the label on.
Ellisa, who was exploring Hao Ning's body, encountered a problem, that is, she faced a house like a turtle shell and couldn't get in no matter what.
Suddenly, a powerful force enveloped her body and pulled her outward. The last time Ellisa felt such fearful power was in the era of the gods!
But where does this power come from now? Before Ellisa could react, she felt a force pulling him out of Hao Ning's body, followed by a ruthless squeeze, as if she was trying to stuff her into a small jar as big as a fist.
"Ah! How could you have..."
Before Ellisa finished speaking, she was pulled into the air. She and Daisy turned into light and merged into the revolver on the ground. In an instant, black light and white light shone back and forth on the gun body, like a collision between water and fire.
Suddenly, Hao Ning was violently thrown aside by this burst of power. He felt that his waist was almost broken as he was injured more and more.
"Boom!"
Suddenly, the surging purple magic patterns on the ground were like a dam with the plug pulled out. The raging purple magic patterns gathered into a huge beam of light and soared into the sky, passing through the rock formations above the secret room and continuing to rush upward.
If you were outside Phoenix right now, you would definitely see a purple beam of light running through the sky!
At the same time, the life-devouring magic patterns on the ground were fading away little by little.
